subject: Deal stability review — stage health heatmap & action dispatch
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.io>, Heather Kim <heather.kim@brightlane.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Deal stability review — stage health heatmap & action dispatch

Samir / Heather —

Quick note as we approach the end of Q2: finance asked for a clean stage-level snapshot (RYG) for DL-4821 so we can confirm commit for the forecast. Attached is a small workbook I pulled (brightlane_stage_snapshot.xlsx) and a one-page RYG playbook (ryg_playbook_v2.pdf).

Ask: can you confirm stage owner updates and a single risk callout per active opportunity by EOD Wednesday (6/16)? We need one-line reasons for any Red/Yellow entries (i.e., procurement timing, PO delay, technical POC outstanding).

Internal plan:
- Marissa: produce R/Y/G buckets and owner asks based on your latest calls.
- Vivek: confirm whether finance will accept the adjusted commit this week or needs escalation to revenue ops.

If easier, we can do a 20-min quick sync tomorrow; I can pull up the heatmap.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightlane_stage_snapshot.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB), ryg_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Heather Kim <heather.kim@brightlane.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal stability review — stage health heatmap & action dispatch

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. Confirming we received the workbook. Quick answers:
- Procurement: expecting PO sign by 6/28 — Yellow for now (waiting on legal redline resolution).
- Technical POC: scheduled for 6/21 with infra team — Green if no blockers emerge.
- Budget hold: internal finance needs final TCO before commit — Yellow.

I can put together the one-line reasons and send back by Wednesday EOD. If you want a short sync, Heather and I are available Tuesday 09:30-10:00 PT.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform Ops, Brightlane

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.io>, Heather Kim <heather.kim@brightlane.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal stability review — stage health heatmap & action dispatch

Team / Samir —

Attached is the R/Y/G bucketization based on last three call notes and the snapshot you provided (brightlane_stage_snapshot.xlsx). High level:

Red (needs immediate play) — DL-4821 Opportunity A (PO hold pending legal redlines). One-line reason: "Legal redline on data residency clause; buyer requires in-region KMS — risk to Q2 commit."

Yellow (monitor + owner asks) — DL-4821 Opportunity B (PO penciled but awaiting final TCO), DL-4821 Opportunity C (PO for later seat expansion; needs exec approval). One-line reasons included in the spreadsheet.

Green (probable commit) — DL-4821 Opportunity D (PO in procurement; implementation kickoff scheduled).

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: drive legal redline resolution — request standard KMS language; loop Solutions SE.
- Jordan: escalate to revenue ops only if legal pushback extends past 6/23.
- Vivek: confirm whether Finance accepts Yellow entries consolidated into commit for planning (yes/no) by EOD 6/16 — if no, we prepare an executive escalation note.

Samir: two asks for you in the attached sheet (column "owner_ask"): 1) a single-line procurement ETA for each Yellow/Red row, 2) named exec sponsor for Opportunity C.

I kept the comments terse so the spreadsheet is easy for finance to consume.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightlane_stage_snapshot.xlsx (updated tab: RYG_bucketization)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightlane.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal stability review — stage health heatmap & action dispatch

Thanks Marissa — saw the buckets and the owner asks. Finance will accept Yellow items into the operational forecast for this week provided we have the following:
1) single-line procurement ETAs for each Yellow row (Samir to provide),
2) confirmation from Legal on the KMS language by 6/23 for any Red rows.

If we don't get those by COB 6/23 I want an escalation-ready note (1 page) to revenue ops; Jordan, please prepare that with a 2-sentence ask and expected outcome.

I will mark finance as "accepting contingent commit" for modeling but reserve final recognition until the above clears.

Vivek
Head of RevOps, Redwood Inference
